characterDescription: A minimal, floating navigation that uses fluid viewport-relative sizing and precise negative-margin offsetting to achieve a visually detached, hovering presence — characteristic of high-craft creative studios that treat the nav as a spatial element rather than a bar. Nav links carry a deliberate 0.08em letter spacing that amplifies the editorial authority of the Clash Display typeface at small scales.
